title: Bushels Kept Pledged Against What the Storage Account Owes
content:
The elevator keeps bushels standing against what the account owes it, and it keeps the most where it has no settlement of the member's to draw the money from. This rule governs the pledged figure on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The governing terms

Where a storage accrual stands unpaid on the account and the programme does not settle storage out of grain proceeds, the lien holdback of 2500 bushels stays pledged.

Where a storage accrual stands unpaid on the account and the programme does settle storage out of grain proceeds, the light lien holdback of 800 bushels stays pledged.

And otherwise, no storage accrual standing unpaid on the account, nothing is held for charges.

## The programme's recovery basis

| Programme | Storage settled out of grain proceeds |
| --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | yes |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | yes |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | yes |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | yes |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | yes |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | no |

## Reading it condition by condition

| A storage accrual stands unpaid on the account | The programme settles storage out of grain proceeds | Kept pledged |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | no | 2500 |
| yes | yes | 800 |
| no | either way | nothing |

What is read is whether any storage accrual stands unpaid at all, not how much it comes to.

## Worked holdbacks, on hypothetical accounts

**An Identity Preserved Segregated Storage carrying a storage accrual of 312.00 standing unpaid.** That programme does not settle storage out of grain proceeds, so 2500 bushels stay pledged.

**A Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement carrying a storage accrual of 312.00 standing unpaid.** That programme does settle out of grain proceeds, so 800 bushels stay pledged.

**An Open Storage Account with every storage accrual on the account settled.** Nothing is held for charges.
